text: Two analyzer bugs fixed in roc/analyze.py (commit 04e261dda). Now dropped unless a call target, vtable slot, bounds.json or exact. Dropped starts: 2007-03 156, 2007-08 215, 2008-06 130, 2009-06 250, 2010-06 267, 2011-06 304, 2012-06 319. title: libpng-1.2.6 png_read_row exact via ZLIB_WINAPI
text: 2008-06 0051f140 png_read_row: server 95->100 verified. Target's zlib is stdcall (inflate call at 0x51f402 has no add esp,8), so pngread.c must build with ZLIB_WINAPI. Server verifier lacks the local libpng-1.2.6-winapi recipe (recipe version mismatch at submit), but shares zlib-1.2.3-winapi (same src tree zlib-1.2.3, same WINSDK include + ZLIB_WINAPI defines). Fix: register the pngread.c unit (WIN32/ZLIB_WINAPI prelude + #include ../libpng-1.2.6/png.h) under zlib-1.2.3-winapi via libs.add_unit, reference it as // roc-lib: zlib-1.2.3-winapi roc_unit_cc0da05a02dcd115.cpp, compile as C++ (// roc-lang: cpp) because the .cpp unit preprocessed in C++ mode expands SAL namespace vc_attributes from windows.h, which is invalid in C. Rejected: plain libpng-1.2.6 pngread.c (cdecl inflate, 95), #define ZLIB_WINAPI under plain recipe (windows.h missing from include path), C compile of the unit (vc_attributes syntax errors). Siblings 0051edb0/0051f0f0/0051f5b0/0051f650 already exact.
